newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farm ministers show "green fingers".
newsitem.headline: EU farm ministers show "green fingers".

text.p: European Union farm ministers on Tuesday put down their papers and picked up spades to plant saplings as a contribution to the European Tree Festival.
"It demonstrates that agricultural ministers have green fingers," said a Dutch EU Presidency official.
Identical hawthorn trees, festooned with rain-soaked national flags and white bunting, were planted by each of the 15 ministers as well as EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler.
They added a green touch to the cavernous, cobbled courtyard of the EU's headquarters in Brussels, where Dutch schoolchildren performed songs and dances.
